regionalPreferences.overviewFaqIntro: Each answer is a few lines so you can skim without opening every settings tab. Expand a question when you need more detail about language, region, formats, or currency display.
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqSavedQuestion: What does Saved mean on this page?
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqSavedAnswer: Saved means you chose a value on the matching settings tab and it is stored on your account. The green badge marks fields with a stored value. Open the linked page from Change to update or clear what is stored.
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqDefaultAnswer: Default means no value is stored for that field yet. Until you save one, the product uses your current interface locale, the region implied by the URL, or familiar browser defaults. Saving on a tab replaces the default for that field only.
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqAppsQuestion: Do these settings apply in every app?
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqAppsAnswer: Only where this product reads your account preferences. Some apps may still use their own locale from the URL or local storage on that device. Signed-in experiences that support regional preferences share the values you save here.
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqLanguageQuestion: How is saved language different from the URL locale?
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqLanguageAnswer: The locale in the URL controls this visit when it is present in the address. Your saved language is used when the URL does not specify one. Changing language from the Language tab can reload this app so menus and messages match your choice.
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqCurrencyQuestion: Does preferred currency change charges or balances?
regionalPreferences.overviewFaqCurrencyAnswer: No. Preferred currency only affects how amounts may be shown in the interface later. It does not convert prices at checkout, change payout currency, or rewrite amounts on invoices and ledger entries.
